accepted_claim: Customer and maintainer documentation is ready for the local static/extracted-package candidate boundary. It may proceed to TestForge but is not visually approved, accessibility-conformant, fresh-host accepted, published, or customer-tested.

repaired_findings.statement: The original CLI receipt reported failed non-PTY probes while claiming PASS.
repaired_findings.resolution: Replaced by five exit-zero PTY probes with raw transcripts; the failed TERM=dumb control is explicitly excluded from the oracle.

repaired_findings.statement: The documentation project used string items where the published schema requires objects and its cutoff preceded successful CLI evidence.
repaired_findings.resolution: Audience, task, and source records were converted to objects; timestamps advanced; bundled and published-schema validation pass.

conditions.title: Direct visual and responsive review
conditions.statement: All twelve PNGs were freshly captured and their bytes, dimensions, and hashes verified, but no pixels were inspected. No conclusion may be drawn about clipping, hierarchy, spacing, rendered contrast, visual polish, or mobile behavior beyond capture.
conditions.closure: Inspect the bound renders through a permitted visual route and capture priority pages at mobile size; rerun the visual-review record.

conditions.title: Keyboard and assistive technology
conditions.statement: Static semantics pass, but keyboard-only navigation, focus order in use, screen-reader output, and representative assistive technology were not exercised. No WCAG or assistive-technology conformance is claimed.
conditions.closure: Run keyboard traversal and at least one representative screen-reader exercise across principal journeys.

conditions.title: Fresh-host acceptance
conditions.statement: Codex command syntax is present in local CLI help, but installation, discovery, enabled state, restart behavior, Nova invocation, specialist routing, and Claude-compatible import were not performed.
conditions.closure: Run fresh-host install, discovery, restart, invocation, and import before live-host claims.

conditions.title: Publication and external links
conditions.statement: Redistribution permission is documented, but no tag, push, release, site deployment, directory listing, announcement, or published-link check occurred.
conditions.closure: After separately authorized publication, check deployed routes and external destinations.

conditions.title: Representative-user completion
conditions.statement: No representative customer was observed completing installation, rights-custody, state, upgrade, or recovery tasks.
conditions.closure: Run bounded representative-user task observation before customer-validated claims.

evidence_boundary: This review establishes documentation source integrity, static accessibility structure, reader-task coverage, procedural and recovery completeness, local CLI-help compatibility, extracted-package parity, and rights custody for the frozen local candidate. It does not establish pixel-level rendering quality, formal accessibility conformance, keyboard or screen-reader behavior, cross-browser behavior, fresh-host installation or invocation, published-link availability, publication, or representative-user outcomes.
